brief.name: Echo Vault
brief.pitch: Listen to short tone patterns and rebuild them on a pad to open the vault door.
mechanics: Players listen to short tone patterns, then rebuild them on a pad
Pattern memory is the core challenge
facts: No ads in the first 20 vaults
Built around listening to and recreating tone patterns
not_true: Does not claim to be ad-free beyond the first 20 vaults
Headphones are not required to play
brief.launch_goal: Reach music and rhythm game players and build an audience among them at launch.

concepts.audience_note: Players who like free mobile games but are tired of interruptions and monetisation tricks. They want to start playing without friction or gimmicks.
concepts.angle: Lead with the first 20 vaults being free of ads, so new players get a real run before any interruption.

meta.headline: 20 vaults before a single ad.
meta.text: Listen to a tone pattern, rebuild it on the pad, and open the vault. No ads in the first 20 vaults. Free to play.
